newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon has hold on Kemira.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon has hold on Kemira.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said in a research note received on Tuesday it had initiated coverage of Finnish chemicals group Kemira Oy with a 'hold' recommendation.

"Despite an excellent period of outperformance against the Finnish index over the past 12 months, Kemira remains attractively valued compared with some of the other Finnish base industry companies," Salomon said.
Its hold recommendation was based on the lack of "a short-term driver to further outperformance".

Salomon said its earnings forecasts for Kemira -- 1996 operating profit at 1.26 billion markka, down from 1.34 billion in 1995, and 1996 EPS at 4.46 markka, down from 4.6 markka -- were "well below consensus".

"The operating earnings outlook for 1997 and 1998 is robust," Salomon said, targeting Kemira's 1997 EPS at 5.6 markka and 1998 EPS at 6.1 markka. Those figures would give P/Es of 10.0 and 9.2 respectively, it said.
With the Finnish market seen trading at 14 times 1997, "Kemira is therefore trading at a substantial discount to the market," Salomon said.
